AI Online Video Editor v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a cloud video editor for fast, AI-powered editing of MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Allows users to upload raw footage, specify editing instructions, and receive processed 1080p MP4 output in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles token-based authentication with automatic anonymous token retrieval and session management.
- Exposes core workflows: video upload, AI editing, timeline preview, credits check, and export/download.
- Includes detailed error handling and clear user feedback throughout processing.
- Tailored for content creators and marketers seeking quick, no-desktop editing solutions.
